text: Karen Gray, Director, Service System Planning and Policy Development, Children's Services, will give a presentation on the outcome of proposals that were jointly submitted by the City of Toronto and its Indigenous planning partners to the Ministry of Education's "The Journey Together: Ontario's Commitment to Reconciliation with Indigenous Peoples" initiative. She will also outline the implementation of the resulting funding from this proposal process which will significantly expand Indigenous-led early years programs and services in the City of Toronto.
The Aboriginal Affairs Committee received the item for information.
